name: Sheet Pan Sausage-Stuffed Portobellos with Cheese, Broccoli & Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
3 crowns broccoli
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Rub with oil, then season with salt and pepper; transfer to the baking sheet, cap-side down, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Divide between a large and a medium bowl. (Set medium bowl aside for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the large bowl with the Parmesan along with sausage, bread crumbs, vinegar, and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
0.68 kg ground pork sausage
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide the sausage mixture between mushrooms (about 2 tablespoons each). Using your hands, spread the mixture over the inside of each mushroom in an even layer, gently pressing to adhere.
Place mushrooms in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until they begin to soften, 10-12 minutes.

Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a clean large bowl, along with the tomatoes. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer broccoli and tomatoes to another large baking sheet, spreading them out in an even layer.
When the mushrooms are starting to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven. Sprinkle remaining Parmesan over the mushrooms.
Place both baking sheets in the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender and sausage is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide stuffed mushrooms and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
